mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.user_id, i.target_type, i.target_id, i.type, i.content, i.parent_id, i.like_count, i.status, i.create_time, u.nickname AS userNickname, u.avatar AS userAvatar FROM interaction i LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.type = 3 AND i.status = 1 AND i.target_type = #{targetType} AND i.target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interaction WHERE deleted = 0 AND type = 3 AND status = 1 AND target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}
